reviews.text: Attended the 1-2-1 training tonight and received a much needed personalised training session for my 16month old Bulldog. The trainers were able to adapt their methods to the needs of my dog which involved alot on focus and building our bond.  They have provided me with information on aftercare, correspondence and reassurance that they are available to discuss progress, difficulties etc. Would definitely recommend training with The Dogs Trust Yorkshire.

Had a 1-2-1 on mouthing at the St Mary's location and it was such a great help! We got great information and a bunch of activities to do with our rescue dog to help her settle in with us and get her more comfortable on walks. JooDee has improved loads in less than a week from the session and things are just gonna continue improving. Also dogs trust really go above and beyond to help dog owners, we received help from their support lines, online training and personal emails all for free before the session and they also give huge discounts to low income households that really make dog training accessible for everyone!
Amy and Bradley were fantastic in our 121 session. Great to get personalised tips and put them in to practise.

Amy and Brad were brilliant. Very patient with my exuberant cocker spaniel.

We both learned a lot. Very enjoyable.

Fantastic 1-2-1 session with Amy and Bradley in Mirfield with our 1 year old Labrador to focus on loose lead walking.  Across the hour they gave us lots of information and techniques on walking our puppy with a happy lead and ways to keep her focused on us instead of distractions.  Fantastic session and would happily recommend.
Fantastic experience with knowledgeable trainers. Both myself and the dog really enjoyed it. Nothing was too much trouble

Excellent 1:1 training session to support my very reactive dog. Straightforward strategies discussed and practiced. We both enjoyed the session and though we both have lots to work on I genuinely now feel I have a plan going forward with Tillie.
Thank you.

The Dog trust Training course is fabulous. The staff are really kind and knowledgeable and we felt at ease the whole time.
As a result of the 4 session course Piper is much more responsive when we ask a command
We would recommend the dogs trust courses. ( they also do 1 to 1 courses too )  Thanks guys
